finding.claim: Broken access control (IDOR): /invoice/<inv_id> returns any invoice by ID with no authentication or ownership check, while sibling /my/invoice/<inv_id> enforces customer == g.user['id'].
finding.source: URL path parameter inv_id from any (including unauthenticated) HTTP client
finding.sink: jsonify(inv) returning full invoice record, invoices.py:10

trace.note: route /invoice/<inv_id> registered with no auth decorator or before_request
INVOICES.get(inv_id) loads by id only; no tenant/owner scoping
entire invoice dict returned to caller

finding.guards_checked: No before_request/auth decorator in file; no g.user check in this handler (contrast lines 16-17 in get_my_invoice, and line 23 in list_mine). Only control is a 404 on missing id, which is not authorization.

verdict.guard_found: none (only abort(404) on missing id at invoices.py:9; no auth decorator, before_request, or g.user check; invoices.py is the only .py file)
verdict.reason: invoices.py:7-10 serves any invoice from INVOICES by id to any caller with no auth or ownership check, unlike the sibling handler's customer check at invoices.py:16-17.
